questions.q: P's income is 150 percent of Q's income and P's expenditure is 60 percent of Q's expenditure. If Q saves 20 percent of his income, then how much percentage does P save of his own income?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, P aur Q ki income ka ratio 3:2 hai. Options integers me hain, toh calculation easy karne ke liye base ko 300 aur 200 maan le taaki zeroes kat jayein aur decimal ka lafda na rahe.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Q ki income 200 maan. Usne 20\% bachaya, yani 40 bachaya, toh kharcha hua 160. P ka kharcha Q ke kharche (160) ka 60\% hai, matlab $160 \times 0.6 = 96$. P ki income 300 thi, usme se 96 udaya toh bacha 204. Seedha percentage nikal: $\frac{204}{300} \times 100 = 68\%$.

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Agar tu x aur y variables banayega, toh linear equations fasa dengi. Ratio base-shifting laga. $Income - Expenditure = Savings$ ka base fraction hi set kar le. Bina x-y ke values assume karna hi real CGL preparation hai.

**Exam Takeaway:** Base values aisi assume kar jisme zeroes jyada hon. Percentage calculations me decimals se bachna hi speed badhata hai.

Calculation StepValue
A. Q's Expenditure1. $200 - 40 = 160$
B. P's Expenditure2. $160 \times 0.60 = 96$
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling (Ratio Base Shifting)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, P aur Q ki income ka ratio 3:2 hai. Yahan hume do alag ratios (Income aur Expenditure) ko ek same scale par laana hai bina variables (x, y) maane. Is ninja technique ko 'Make it Equal and Scale' kehte hain.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):
Humare paas do alag ratios hain:
Income (I) $\rightarrow$ P : Q = 3 : 2
Expenditure (E) $\rightarrow$ P : Q = 3 : 5

Condition: Q saves 20% of his income. Yani Q ka kharcha (E) uski income ka 80% hai. Toh Q ke liye: I : E = 100 : 80 = 5 : 4.
Bas ab hume Q ki values ko 5 : 4 ke ratio me set karna hai.

Step 1: Q ko pehle barabar (Equal) kar le.
Income ko 5 se aur Expenditure ko 2 se multiply kar:
I $\rightarrow$ 15 : 10
E $\rightarrow$ 6 : 10

Step 2: Ab Q ko 5 : 4 ke scale par set kar de.
I ko 5 se, E ko 4 se multiply kar:
I $\rightarrow$ (15 $\times$ 5) : (10 $\times$ 5) $\rightarrow$ 75 : 50
E $\rightarrow$ (6 $\times$ 4) : (10 $\times$ 4) $\rightarrow$ 24 : 40

Step 3: Magic Happens!
Check kar, Q ki income 50 hai aur kharcha 40 (jo ki 80% hai). Condition set!
Ab P ka data utha:
P Income = 75, P Expenditure = 24 $\rightarrow$ Savings = 75 - 24 = 51.
Percentage Saving = $\frac{51}{75} \times 100 = \frac{17}{25} \times 100 = 17 \times 4 = 68\%$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Q ki 5 units (E) = 80% of Q's Income (2 units of I).
So, $5E = \frac{4}{5} \times 2I \implies 5E = \frac{8}{5} I \implies 1E = \frac{8}{25} I$.
P ka Kharcha = $3E = 3 \times \frac{8}{25} I = \frac{24}{25} I$.
P ki Income = $3I$. P ki Bachat = $3I - \frac{24}{25}I = \frac{51}{25}I$.
Savings % = $\frac{\frac{51}{25}I}{3I} \times 100 = \frac{17}{25} \times 100 = 68\%$.

Exam Takeaway: Method 1 is ultimate! Jab bhi do ratios ko aapas me fraction se link karna ho, toh LCM le kar Equal kar le, phir required ratio se Scale kar de. Zero variable, full marks!

questions.q: The cost of packaging of the mangoes is 40% the cost of fresh mangoes themselves. The cost of mangoes increased by 30% but the cost of packaging decreases by 50%, then the percentage change of the cost of packed mangoes, if the cost of packed mangoes is equal to the sum of the cost of fresh mangoes and cost of packaging:
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Product aur packaging dono alag rate se badh/ghat rahe hain. Direct base 100 maan, add kar, aur nayi values compare kar le.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Mangoes ki cost 100 maan, packaging ho gayi 40. Total ho gaya 140. Ab mangoes 30\% badh kar 130 hue, aur packaging 50\% ghat kar 20 reh gayi. Naya total = 130 + 20 = 150. Increment aya 10 ka, kis par? Purane 140 par! Fraction bana $\frac{10}{140} = \frac{1}{14}$. Direct fraction yaad honi chahiye, $\frac{1}{14}$ matlab 7.14\% Hota hai!

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Concept ye hai ki 'Total Cost' par directly overall percentage nahi lagta jab tak uske internal components alag-alag vary kar rahe hon. Individual parts ka naya sum nikalo tabhi sahi value aayegi.

**Exam Takeaway:** Aise combined cost wale sawaalo me turant 100 base par shift kar jao. $\frac{1}{14} = 7.14\%$ jaise fraction tips par hone chahiye.

Cost ComponentChange Calculation
A. Mangoes (Old -> New)1. $100 \rightarrow 130$ (+30\%)
B. Packaging (Old -> New)2. $40 \rightarrow 20$ (-50\%)

questions.q: The strength of SSC Aspirants increases and decreases every alternate year. It starts with increase by 20% and thereafter the percentage of increase/decrease is the same. Which of the following is definitely true about the strength of SSC Aspirants in 2000 as compared to that in 1996?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, 4 saal ka chain reaction hai: +20\%, -20\%, +20\%, -20\%. Jab bhi same percentage badhe aur ghate, humesha net decrease hi hota hai. Seedha loss ka formula dimag me chamakna chahiye.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Base 100 maan. 4 baar successive chalega: $100 \times 1.2 \times 0.8 \times 1.2 \times 0.8 = 100 \times 0.96 \times 0.96$. 96 ka square nikalna bahut aasan hai (100 se 4 kam hai, toh $96-4=92$ aur $4^2=16$), yani 0.9216. Final value hui 92.16. 100 se ghat kar 92.16 aane me seedha 7.84\% ka decrease!

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Successive ko pairs me tod. +20\% aur -20\% ka ek pair net change $\frac{-20^2}{100} = -4\%$ deta hai. Aise 2 pair hain, yani do baar -4\% ka successive. Net change = $-4 - 4 + \frac{(-4)(-4)}{100} = -8 + 0.16 = -7.84\%$.

**Exam Takeaway:** Successive calculation ko fractions ya pairs me todne se answer hawa me nikalta hai. $x$ badhe aur $x$ ghate $\implies$ Humesha $\frac{x^2}{100}$ ka loss.

Pair BreakdownNet Change
A. First 2 Years (+20\%, -20\%)1. $-4\%$ Loss
B. Next 2 Years (+20\%, -20\%)2. $-4\%$ Loss

questions.q: In a school ratio of number of boys and girls is 16:9. 68.75% of boys and 44.44% of girls went for picnic. Find the percentage of total students who did not go to picnic?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, dangerous percentages ko dekhte hi unka fraction yaad aana chahiye! 68.75\% aur 44.44\% dekh kar darna nahi hai, base 16 aur 9 already hint de rahe hain ki fractions aaram se katenge.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** 68.75\% = $50\% + 18.75\% = \frac{1}{2} + \frac{3}{16} = \frac{11}{16}$. 44.44\% standard $\frac{4}{9}$ hota hai. Boys jo nahi gaye = $1 - \frac{11}{16} = \frac{5}{16}$. 16 ka $\frac{5}{16}$ = 5. Girls jo nahi gayi = $1 - \frac{4}{9} = \frac{5}{9}$. 9 ka $\frac{5}{9}$ = 5. Total nahi gaye = 10. Total strength = 25. Percentage = $\frac{10}{25} \times 100 = 40\%$.

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Fractions convert karke sidha remainder nikal. Agar $\frac{11}{16}$ chale gaye toh $\frac{5}{16}$ bach gaye. Arithmetic game sirf fractions ke base denominator ko target karne ka hota hai.

**Exam Takeaway:** CGL hamesha values ratio aur percentages aisi deta hai jo ek dusre ko cancel karein. Weird percentages me numerator se zyada denominator ko pakdo.

CategoryCalculation (Not Gone)
A. Boys (16)1. $16 \times \frac{5}{16} = 5$
B. Girls (9)2. $9 \times \frac{5}{9} = 5$

questions.q: The average marks of the students in four subjects History, Biology, Chemistry and Physics together is 60%. The average marks of the students in History, Biology, Chemistry and Physics individually are 45%, 50%, 72% and 80% respectively. If the average marks of the students of History and Biology together is 48% and that of the students of Biology and Chemistry together is 60%. What is the ratio of number of students in History and Physics?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, char groups hain, aur combination average (Alligation) ka double layer diya hai. Ratio nikalkar Deviation lagayega toh direct Physics ki value pop out karegi, bina lambe x-y multiplication ke.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Pehle H(45) aur B(50) ko mix karke 48 la $\implies$ H:B ratio = $(50-48):(48-45) = 2:3$. Fir B(50) aur C(72) ko mix karke 60 la $\implies$ B:C ratio = $(72-60):(60-50) = 12:10 = 6:5$. H:B = 4:6 (double kiya taaki merge ho) toh H:B:C = 4:6:5. Total average 60 hai. Deviation base 60 rakh: H(-15) x 4 + B(-10) x 6 + C(+12) x 5 + P(+20) x X = 0. Solve kar: $-60 - 60 + 60 + 20X = 0 \implies 20X = 60 \implies X = 3$. Physics wale 3 hain. Ratio H:P = 4:3.

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Alligation se numbers ka weightage aata hai, aur Deviation us weightage ko balance karta hai. Agar manually total multiply karke add karta toh calculation teri jaan le leti. JSM is king!

**Exam Takeaway:** Jab multiple groups aur unke combined averages diye hon, Alligation aur JSM ka combo hamesha use karo taaki calculation single digit me rahe.

Subject (Students)Deviation from 60
A. History (4 units)1. $45 - 60 = -15$
B. Physics (X units)2. $80 - 60 = +20$

questions.q: A manufacturer reduces the diameter of their spherical bearing balls by 50% to cut costs. What is the percentage decrease in volume of each ball?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, sphere ka Volume radius/diameter ke cube par depend karta hai ($r^3$). Linear (1D) change jab 3D par jata hai, toh 3 baar successive lagta hai. Seedha fraction ka cube soch!

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Diameter 50\% kam hua, yani $\frac{1}{2}$ ban gaya. Pehle 2 tha, ab 1 ho gaya. Volume cubical relation me hai: $2^3 \rightarrow 1^3$, matlab 8 se 1 ban gaya. Drop kitna hua? 7 ka. Fraction nikal $\frac{7}{8}$ aur ye direct percentage value hai 87.5\%. Pen uthane ki jarurat hi nahi thi!

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Formula $\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3$ me $\frac{4}{3}\pi$ constant hai. Isliye sirf $r^3$ ka effect aayega. 50\% drop teen baar = $50+50-25=75$, fir 75 aur 50 me successsive lagaoge toh bahut time jayega, isliye fraction scaling hi best hai.

**Exam Takeaway:** Mensuration percentage questions me hamesha dimension ki degree (power) pakdo. 2D ho toh square aur 3D ho toh seedha cube kar do.

ParameterInitial : Final
A. Diameter (Linear)1. $2 : 1$
B. Volume (Cubic)2. $8 : 1$ (Drop of 7)

questions.q: In an election, there were four candidates and 95% of voters cast their votes. One candidate got 25% of the votes while the other three shared the remaining votes in the ratio of 6:7:2. The difference of votes secured by the candidate standing 3rd to the candidate standing 4th is equal to 69198. Find the votes secured by the winning candidate.
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, vote 4 logon me batein. Ek 25\% le gaya, baaki teeno 75\% lenge. 6:7:2 ka sum hi 15 hai. 15 unit seedha 75\% se map kar, har candidate ka direct percentage aa jayega.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Remaining 75\% ko 15 units (6+7+2) me baant. 1 unit = 5\%. Teeno candidates ko mile 30\%, 35\%, aur 10\%. Ab ranks dekh: 1st=35\%, 2nd=30\%, 3rd=25\% (jo pehle alag kiya tha), 4th=10\%. 3rd aur 4th ka margin: $25\% - 10\% = 15\%$. Ye 15\% = 69198 diya hai. Winner ko pucha hai (yani 35\%). Toh $\frac{69198}{15} \times 35 = 69198 \times \frac{7}{3}$. Unit digit laga! $\frac{69198}{3} = 23066$, last me 6 hai, aur $6 \times 7 = 42$ aakhiri me 2 aayega. Options me sirf 161462 me end me 2 hai. Khatam!

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Jab tu percentages ko ratios ke total se equating karta hai, toh calculation 2x fast ho jati hai. Uske baad Unit Digit aur Divisibility hi lagana hota hai final multiply karne ki jagah.

**Exam Takeaway:** Ratios ko actual percentages ke equal rakhkar common multiplier nikalna seekh aur end me unit digit se khel kar pura multiply bachaya kar.

Candidate RankVote Percentage
A. 1st (Winner)1. $35\%$
B. Difference (3rd & 4th)2. $25\% - 10\% = 15\%$

questions.q: Marks: Eng 45/50; Maths 70/100; Sci 40/50; Hist 55/100. Approx cumulative percentage?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, yaha base bahut simple hain (50 aur 100). Seedha add karna, percentage ya deviation nikalne se jyada fast hai. Total 300 base round figure me baith raha hai.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Total marks acquired = $45 + 70 + 40 + 55 = 210$. Total maximum marks = $50 + 100 + 50 + 100 = 300$. Cumulative percentage = $\frac{210}{300} \times 100 = 70\%$. Ekdum bachho wala sawal hai!

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Agar base ajeeb hote toh hum individual percentage (90\%, 70\%, 80\%, 55\%) nikal kar weighted average ya JSM lagate, par jab direct adding aasan ho, toh apna ego side me rakh kar seedha jodo.

**Exam Takeaway:** DI (Data Interpretation) me pehle denominator check kiya kar, agar simple sum 100, 200, 300 ban raha ho toh shortcuts ki jagah normal addition hi fast hota hai.

SummationValue
A. Obtained Total1. $210$
B. Maximum Total2. $300$

questions.q: A mixture containing 18% methanol is mixed with another mixture containing b% methanol in the ratio 4:5. If the percentage of methanol in the final mixture is 16%, what is the value of b?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 4. Cross-Product Method

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, jab do mixture ko milakar overall mixture banaya jaye aur unka mixing ratio diya ho, toh 'Alligation' se best koi tool nahi hai. JSM/Deviation bhi isko mentally fod dega.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Deviation laga base 16\% par. Pehle hisse me 18\% (yani +2\% jyada hai) aur ye 4 unit hai. Dusre hisse me $b$ hai aur wo 5 unit hai. Total deviation zero hona chahiye: $4 \times (+2) + 5 \times (b - 16) = 0$. Matlab $8 = 5(16 - b) \implies 1.6 = 16 - b \implies b = 14.4\%$. Alligation se bhi ek line choti bani!

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Normal Alligation ki equation: $\frac{18 - 16}{16 - b} = \frac{5}{4}$. Solve karke $2 \times 4 = 5(16 - b) \implies 8 = 80 - 5b \implies 5b = 72 \implies b = 14.4$. Dono same hi cheez hain.

**Exam Takeaway:** Mixture me hamesha center value par deviation balance karna (Net sum = 0) alligation fraction likhne se thoda jyada tezi se dimaag me solve ho jata hai.

Component (Ratio)Deviation Balance
A. Part 1 (4 units)1. $4 \times (+2) = +8$
B. Part 2 (5 units)2. $5 \times (-1.6) = -8$

questions.q: In an election, a candidate secures 42% of the votes polled but is defeated by his only opponent by a majority of 3080 votes, because of 1400 invalid votes. The percentage of invalid votes is:
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, yaha numbers actual aur percentages dono me hain (invalid votes aur majority donno values hain). Yahan tu direct 100 base par nahi khel sakta kyuki invalid votes fix fraction me nahi hain. Simple linear equation frame karni padegi!

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Maan le total polled = $100x$. Loser ko mile $42x$. Invalid hain 1400. Toh Valid votes = $100x - 1400$. Winner ko kitne mile? Valid - Loser = $(100x - 1400) - 42x = 58x - 1400$. Majority = Winner - Loser = $(58x - 1400) - 42x = 16x - 1400$. Ye value margin of defeat hai jo 3080 diya hai. $16x = 4480 \implies x = 280$. Total polled $100x = 28000$. Invalid percentage = $\frac{1400}{28000} \times 100 = 5\%$.

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Agar 1400 votes valid hote (suppose kisi ko nahi milte), toh total margin waisa rehta par votes ki counting shift hoti. Aise logic build up complex kar sakte hain. Jab actual figure absolute count (1400) me ho, toh 'x' tera best friend hai.

**Exam Takeaway:** Agar percentages ke beech koi fix integer ghusa hua ho, toh Unitary approach (100) fail ho jayegi, $100x$ variable use karna secure hota hai.

Entity BreakdownVotes Assigned
A. Loser1. $42x$
B. Winner2. $58x - 1400$

questions.q: Out of her total monthly income, a woman spends 60% on household expenses and 15% on savings. The remaining amount is spent on other items. What percentage of her income is spent on other items?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, sawal me 'remaining' ya 'successive' ka word 60\% aur 15\% ke beech me NAHI hai. Iska matlab dono hisse total 100\% pe directly count hote hain. Aise sawal examiner sirf free number dene ya tumhari padhne ki speed test karne ke liye dalta hai.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Total Income = 100\%. Household gaya 60\%. Saving pe gaya 15\%. Total lag gaya $60 + 15 = 75\%$. Ab sawal poocha hai bacha hua amount (other items) kitna hoga? Seedha $100 - 75 = 25\%$. Option tick kar aur aage badh!

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Trap yeh hai ki jaldbaazi me bachhe "60\% gaya toh 40\% bacha, 40\% ka 15\% nikala" wala concept laga dete hain. Language ko dhyan se padhna is the only key.

**Exam Takeaway:** 'Spent 60\% AND 15\%' aur 'Spent 60\% AND 15\% OF REMAINING' - in dono phrases ka fark exam hall me clear hona chahiye.

Expenditure HeadPercentage Consumed
A. Combined Known (House + Save)1. $60\% + 15\% = 75\%$
B. Other Items2. $100\% - 75\% = 25\%$

questions.q: A number was mistakenly increased by 25% instead of decreased by 20%. By what percent is the final result more than the correct value?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Mistake walo sawalon me hamesha BASE (denominator) us value ko banana hota hai jo 'Sahih' (correct) thi. Original number ko 100 maan, sahi result aur galat result dono nikal.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Base 100 liya. Sahi kaam = 20\% ghatana tha, yani aana chahiye tha 80. Galat kaam = 25\% badha diya, yani le aya 125. Pucha hai final result (125) sahi (80) se kitna percent jyada hai. Value me jyada hai $125 - 80 = 45$. Base sahi value (80) rakh: $\frac{45}{80} \times 100 = \frac{9}{16} \times 100$. $\frac{1}{16}$ hota hai $6.25\%$, toh $9 \times 6.25 = 56.25\%$.

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Ratio method bhi op hai. Sahi value 80, galat 125. Ratio ban gaya $80:125 = 16:25$. Increase hai 9 units ka 16 par. Standard fraction $\frac{9}{16}$ aa gaya seedha!

**Exam Takeaway:** "More than the correct value" likha hai matlab percentage error original number (100) par nahi, balki 'Correct Outcome' (80) par nikalni padegi.

Action StateScale Value
A. Correct Value (Should be)1. $100 \rightarrow 80$
B. Mistaken Value (Actual)2. $100 \rightarrow 125$

questions.q: When (A + 10)% of a number is added to 180, the result is the same number. If 120% of the original number is 540, then find (A - 26)% of the original number.
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, thoda reverse statement diya hai. Jab kisi hisse me ek number jodte hain aur original wapas aa jaye, toh wo joda hua number baaki bacha hua percentage hi hota hai. Statements ulta solve karna best hai.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Pehle original number nikalte hain. $1.2N = 540 \implies N = 450$. Ab condition padh: $(A+10)\%$ hisse me 180 joda toh fir se pura 450 ban gaya. Matlab $450 - 180 = 270$. Ye 270 us number (450) ka kitna part hai? $\frac{270}{450} = \frac{3}{5} = 60\%$. Toh $(A+10) = 60 \implies A = 50$. Pucha kya hai? $(A-26)\%, yani (50-26)\% = 24\%$ nikalna hai 450 ka. $450 \times 0.24 = 108$. Mind math lagayega toh jaldi aayega!

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Concept ye kehta hai ki pura number = 100\%. Toh baaki percentage $100 - (A+10)$ = 180 hoga. Wahan se tu seedha $180 / 450$ karega toh $40\%$ aayega. Yani $100 - (A+10) = 40 \implies A = 50$.

**Exam Takeaway:** Equations banate time base fractions ko side-by-side compare kar liya karo. CGL me "reverse loop" wale questions common hain.

StepCalculation
A. Finding Number (N)1. $540 \div 1.2 = 450$
B. Percentage Part assigned2. $\frac{270}{450} = 60\% \implies A = 50$

questions.q: In an election between two candidates, y% of the voters did not vote. 10% of the votes cast were declared invalid, while all the valid votes were cast in favour of either of the two candidates. The candidate who got 59.375% of the valid votes cast was declared elected by 2484 votes. If the number of people eligible to vote in that election was 16,000, what is the value of y?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, ye election series ka full-blown sawal hai. Isko start se variables man kar chalega toh time lega, isliye Margin se le kar Total Eligible votes tak ki journey "Reverse-Tracking" karke chalni hai.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Winner ko 59.375\% mile toh Loser ko $100 - 59.375 = 40.625\%$. Margin aya $18.75\%$. Iska fraction banao $\frac{3}{16}$. Yani Valid votes ka $\frac{3}{16}$ = 2484. Valid votes = $2484 \times \frac{16}{3} = 13248$. Ye valid votes Casted votes ka 90\% (kyunki 10\% invalid) hain. Casted votes = $\frac{13248}{0.9} = 14720$. Eligible voter 16000 the. Kitno ne vote nahi diya? $16000 - 14720 = 1280$. Total ka percent nikal: $\frac{1280}{16000} \times 100 = 8\%$. Bottom-up approach OP!

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Chain equation banti: $16000 \times (1 - \frac{y}{100}) \times 0.9 \times 0.1875 = 2484$. Is equation me ekmatra unknown $y$ hai. Equation build karo aur direct fraction value se break karo.

**Exam Takeaway:** Election ke questions agar margin, invalid aur total valid de rakhe ho toh last line se solve karna start kiya karo, intermediate fractions kat te chale jayenge.

Layer (Reverse Order)Calculated Value
A. Valid Votes ($2484 \times \frac{16}{3}$)1. $13,248$
B. Casted Votes ($13248 \div 0.9$)2. $14,720$

questions.q: A’s salary is 120% of B’s salary and B spends 60% of his salary for house rent and education fees. If B’s savings is Rs. 1800 and A’s expenditure is 40% more than that of B, then what is the saving amount of A?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, seedha mapping connection diya hai! Data start karna hai B ki absolute value se (1800) aur us se A tak ka pul (bridge) cross karna hai. Link by link flow clear hai.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** B ne 60\% udaya toh 40\% bachaya hoga. B ka 40\% = 1800 de rakha hai. Toh B ki puri income (100\%) hogi 4500. A ki income 120\% hai yani $4500 \times 1.2 = 5400$. B ka expenditure 60\% tha yani 2700. A ka kharch is se 40\% jyada hai, toh A exp = $2700 \times 1.4 = 3780$. A ki saving kya bachi? Income - Exp = $5400 - 3780 = 1620$.

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Tu ratios me base ko 100x aur 120x maan sakta hai, uske baad 40x = 1800 likh kar common multiplier $x=45$ aayega, uske through bhi end result same niklega.

**Exam Takeaway:** Flowchart dimaag me chhap lo: B(save) $\rightarrow$ B(income) $\rightarrow$ A(income), and B(income) $\rightarrow$ B(exp) $\rightarrow$ A(exp). Dono ko ghata do answer ready.

Step LinkageMonetary Value
A. B's Income (40\% = 1800)1. $4500$
B. A's Income (1.2x)2. $5400$

questions.q: After three successive raises, Aftab's salary became equal to $\frac{378}{125}$ times of his initial salary. By what percentage was the salary raised the first time if the third raise was twice as high (in percentage) as the second raise and the second raise was twice as high (in percentage) as the first raise?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, ye question agar x maan ke karega toh ek cubic equation ($x(2x)(4x)$...) ban jayegi aur tu wahin fans jayega. Fraction diya hai $\frac{378}{125} = 3.024$ ka multiplier. Options ko verify karna hi exam nikalne ka shortcut hai.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Options try kar. Agar pehla raise 20\% hai, toh dusra uska double (40\%) aur teesra uska double (80\%). Inka successive lagao: $(1.2) \times (1.4) \times (1.8)$. Check kar: $1.2 \times 1.4 = 1.68$, and $1.68 \times 1.8 = 3.024$. Match kar gaya! Pehla option hi answer ho gaya.

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Conceptually, $\frac{378}{125}$ approx 3 times growth hai. Agar pehla 10\% lega (Op D), toh 1.1x1.2x1.4 = 1.84 banega jo bahut chhota hai. Agar 25\% (Op C) lega toh 1.25x1.5x2.0 = 3.75 banega jo bada ho jayega. Range definition (approximation) se bhi answer nikal aata.

**Exam Takeaway:** Successive change me agar multiplier weird decimal ya bada fraction ho aur multiple unknown changes pooche hon, HAMESHA reverse options elimination ka sahara liya kar.

Option CheckedSuccessive Multiplier
A. $20\% (1.2 \times 1.4 \times 1.8)$1. $3.024$ (Matches $\frac{378}{125}$)
B. $10\% (1.1 \times 1.2 \times 1.4)$2. $1.848$ (Too small)

questions.q: In an election between P, R and S, $\frac{1}{10}$ of the total votes polled are invalid. Votes polled in favour of R and S are half of the total votes polled, and they get equal votes. Due to a fault in the machine, half of the votes of S and half of the invalid votes are counted additionally in favour of R. What is the overall percentage of votes secured by R due to the fault?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Total votes base ko 100 maan, kyuki distribution fractions aur 'half' me diye hain, decimals nahi ayenge aur direct percent nikal jayega overall 100 par.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Total votes = 100. Invalid hue 10. Valid bache 90. R aur S ka total milakar half hai (yani 50), aur equal baant lo toh R=25, S=25. Ab machine fault dekhte hain: S ke aadhe votes (12.5) aur Invalid ke aadhe (5) seedha R ki jholi me aagaye. R ko total kitne mile? $25 (original) + 12.5 + 5 = 42.5$. Total votes 100 the, toh percentage seedha 42.5\% ban gaya.

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Logical branching bana le. Total = P+R+S+Invalid. Hamein bas R se matlab tha, P ki value nikalne ki zarurat hi nahi padhi (P = valid me bacha 90 - 50 = 40 hoga). Faltu variables me dimag nahi daudana.

**Exam Takeaway:** "Overall percentage" poocha gaya hai isliye base Valid (90) nahi, balki Polled (100) hi rahega. Language trap se bachna.

Source of R's VotesVotes (Base 100)
A. Original Share1. $25$
B. Fault (from S & Invalid)2. $12.5 + 5 = 17.5$

questions.q: In an election, only two candidates participated. 80% of people cast their votes and 900 people did not cast their votes. 25% of the votes are declared invalid. If the winner won by 300 valid votes, then find the total number of voters?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, ye question tumhe invalid aur winner votes dikha ke gumrah kar raha hai. Pehli do line hi kaafi hain answer fodne ke liye. Aage ki ramayan ignore mar de.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Question padh: 80\% logo ne vote dala aur bache hue 900 logo ne nahi dala. Toh bhai seedhi baat hai na, jo 20\% log bach gaye wahi toh 900 hain! Agar 20\% = 900 hai, toh Total (100\%) nikalne ke liye 5 guna kar de. $900 \times 5 = 4500$. Khatam! Niche ki invalid aur winner ki kahani padhne wala time waste karega.

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Examiner intentionally surplus data deta hai CGL me. Real skill aakhiri puchi hui cheez ko upar padh ke check karne me hai ki kaunsa data zaroori hai.

**Exam Takeaway:** Ek smart SSC aspirant hamesha pura structure samajh kar shortcut talashta hai. Over-solving is a disease, bhai!

Extracted DataCalculation Logic
A. Did not vote (%)1. $100\% - 80\% = 20\%$
B. Total Voters2. $900 \times 5 = 4500$

questions.q: In a workshop, the ratio of skilled to unskilled workers is 5: 4. After a hiring drive, the number of skilled workers increased by 10%, while the number of unskilled workers increased by 25%. What is the new ratio of skilled to unskilled workers?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, ratio ke components alag-alag rate par badh rahe hain, seedha dummy base bana jisme 100x ka multiplier ho taaki percentage badhane me decimal nahi bane.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Ratio 5:4 ko asani ke liye 500 aur 400 maan le. Skilled me 10\% increase hua (50 badha), toh ye ho gaye 550. Unskilled me 25\% (yani chautha hissa $\frac{1}{4}$) increase hua, 400 ka $\frac{1}{4}$ hua 100, toh ye ho gaye 500. Naya ratio nikal: $550 : 500$. Zero kaat ke 5 se divide kar, result aaya $11 : 10$.

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Direct multiplier fractions se lagao. Skilled $= 5 \times 1.1 = 5.5$. Unskilled $= 4 \times 1.25 = 5.0$. Ratio $5.5 : 5.0 = 55 : 50 = 11 : 10$. Yaha tumhare multiples strong hone chahiye.

**Exam Takeaway:** Jab bhi initial data ratio me ho aur alag percentage badhana ho, usme utne zeroes laga do jitne ki calculation percentage smooth karein (commonly base 100 scale).

CategoryUpdated Amount
A. Skilled Workers1. $500 + 50 = 550$
B. Unskilled Workers2. $400 + 100 = 500$

questions.q: An employee contributes 20% of their salary to charity. From the remaining amount, 40% is allocated to investments. The rest is divided for education and travel in the ratio 7:5. If the expense on travel is 6,000, what is the employee's total salary?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, lagataar "remaining" chal raha hai, matlab chain method se end tak pohochna hai. End me fraction lagakar value equal kar de.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Total salary 100\% maan. 20\% daan me gaya, bacha 80\%. Ab is 80\% ka 40\% (yani 32\%) invest gaya. Bacha kitna? $80 - 32 = 48\%$. Is 48\% ko Education aur Travel me 7:5 me todna hai. 7+5=12 units. Agar 12 unit = 48\% hai, toh 1 unit = 4\%. Travel ka hissa 5 unit yani $20\%$ hoga. Travel par 6000 lag raha hai. Toh total ka 20\% agar 6000 hai, toh 100\% kitna hoga? Seedha 5 guna kar de = 30000.

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Line equation aise banao: $Total \times \frac{4}{5} \times \frac{3}{5} \times \frac{5}{12} = 6000$. Ise kaatoge toh direct $Total \times \frac{1}{5} = 6000 \implies Total = 30000$ aayega. Line equation time bachati hai!

**Exam Takeaway:** Jab chain aakhir tak jaye aur absolute value end hisse ki de rakhi ho, toh continuous fraction (Successive) hamesha best hit karta hai.

Distribution LayerRemaining Balance (%)
A. After Charity (20\%)1. $80\%$
B. After Investment (40\% of 80)2. $48\%$

questions.q: A fruit seller had total (X+50) mangoes and apples. He sold 20% mangoes to A, 40% of remaining to B and had 48 mangoes left. Similarly, he sold 40% apples to A, 100 apples to B and had 10% apples left. Find (X+500).
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, dono fruits ka track ek dum alag hai, mangoes me seedha percentage successive hai aur apples me percentage ke beech absolute number (100) mixed hai. Dono ko alag alag handle kar!

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Mangoes(M): 20\% bika (bacha 80\%), fir 40\% bika (bacha 60\%). Equate kar de: $M \times 0.8 \times 0.6 = 48 \implies 0.48M = 48 \implies M = 100$.
Apples(A): 40\% becha toh bacha 60\%. Ab isme se 100 beche toh end me 10\% bache. Equation bani $0.6A - 100 = 0.1A \implies 0.5A = 100 \implies A = 200$. Total fruits (X+50) hue $100+200 = 300$. Yaha se X = 250 aaya. Pucha X+500 hai, yani $250+500 = 750$.

**Successive Change (The Chain Reaction) & Unitary Scaling.

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First:
Dekh bhai, Mangoes aur Apples dono ke events bilkul independent hain. Exam me variable `X` dekh kar ghabrana nahi hai. Sabse best hack hai ki pehle individual fruits ki total sankhya percentage ya ratio se nikal lo, aur last me unko add karke `X+50` se equate kar do. Tune jo 3 methods diye hain, aao sabka post-mortem karte hain.

Method 1 (Percentage Base Shift - Ninja Technique):
Mangoes: Let total = 100\%.
Remaining after 20\% sold = 80\%.
Remaining after 40\% of 80\% sold = 80\% \times 60\% = 48\%.
ATQ, 48\% \equiv 48 \Rightarrow 100\% \equiv 100 mangoes.

Apples: Let total = 100\%.
Sold to A = 40\%. Bacha hua 60\%.
Ab isme se 100 apples B ko diye, toh 10\% bache.
Iska sidha observation hai: 60\% - 10\% = 50\%. Ye 50\% hi 100 apples ke barabar hain!
50\% \equiv 100 \Rightarrow 100\% \equiv 200 apples.

Total fruits = 100 + 200 = 300.
So, X + 50 = 300 \Rightarrow X = 250.
Find: X + 500 = 250 + 500 = 750.

Method 2 (Fractional Successive Ratio - Exam Approach):
Mangoes (Successive Change):
20\% = \frac{1}{5} (Base shift: 5 se 4), 40\% = \frac{2}{5} (Base shift: 5 se 3).
InitialFinal
54
53
2512
12 units \equiv 48 \Rightarrow 1 unit = 4.
Total Mangoes = 25 \times 4 = 100.

Apples (Direct Observation):
Total = 100\%. Sold to A = 40\%, Remaining = 10\%.
Consumed percentage without absolute value = 40\% + 10\% = 50\%.
Rest 50\% is exactly the 100 apples given to B.
50\% \equiv 100 \Rightarrow 100\% = 200.
Total = 300, X = 250, Ans = 750.

Method 3 (Basic Variable Equation - The Trap):
Ye teri 3rd image wala approach hai, jo ekdum basic hai. Exam me ye nahi lagana hai!
Mangoes = 100 (derived). Total fruits = X + 50.
So, Total Apples = (X + 50) - 100 = (X - 50).
ATQ for apples:
Sold 40\% (i.e. \frac{2}{5}), remaining = \frac{3}{5}.
(X - 50) \times \frac{3}{5} - 100 = (X - 50) \times \frac{1}{10}
(X - 50) \times \frac{3}{5} - (X - 50) \times \frac{1}{10} = 100
(X - 50) \times \frac{1}{2} = 100
(X - 50) = 200 \Rightarrow X = 250.
Bhai, isme expression balance karne me time jayega. It's a pure waste of 30-40 seconds.


Future Exam Takeaway (Hack Observation):
Exam me hamesha Method 1 ya 2 lagana hai. Jab question me do alag-alag items (Mangoes aur Apples) ho, toh starting ke combined variable (X+50) ko temporarily bhool jao. Individual parts ko 100\% base ya ratio base par solve karo, unki real values nikal kar last me combine karo. Variables ke jaal me tab tak nahi fasna jab tak strictly necessary na ho!

questions.q: Sushil's monthly salary is 20% of Pankaj's annual salary. Yash's monthly salary is 3/4th of Sushil's monthly salary. If the monthly salary of Pankaj is Rs 15000, what is the annual salary of Yash?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling (Equating units to real values)

Pen-Free Observation: Pankaj ki monthly 15k hai, toh chain reaction me Yash ki annual kafi badi aayegi. Pura khela sirf clear base-shifting ka hai. Question ke keywords 'Monthly' aur 'Annual' ko dhyan se dekhna hai aur single line me execution karna hai. Maximum bacche ratio me Pankaj ki annual value ko uski monthly se equate karke Concept Leakage kar dete hain!

Method 1 (The Chain Reaction - Exam Approach):
Aise simple chain problems me ratio banake time waste mat kar. Jab clear percentage aur fraction diye hon, toh peeche se single line execution kar:
  • Pankaj (Monthly) = 15,000
  • Pankaj (Annual) = 15,000 $\times$ 12 = 1,80,000
  • Sushil (Monthly) = 20% of Pankaj (Annual) = $\frac{1}{5} \times 1,80,000 = 36,000$
  • Yash (Monthly) = $\frac{3}{4}$ of Sushil (Monthly) = $\frac{3}{4} \times 36,000 = 27,000$
  • Yash (Annual) = 27,000 $\times$ 12 = 3,24,000


Method 2 (Ratio Scaling Correction):
Agar tu ratio banata hai $S : P(\text{Annual}) : Y = 4 : 20 : 3$, toh yaad rakh 20 units Pankaj ki Annual salary hai, monthly nahi.
Pankaj (Annual) = 15,000 $\times$ 12 = 1,80,000.
So, 20 units = 1,80,000 $\implies$ 1 unit = 9,000.
Yash (Monthly) = 3 units = 3 $\times$ 9,000 = 27,000.
Yash (Annual) = 27,000 $\times$ 12 = 3,24,000.

Exam Takeaway: Method 1 is the safest and fastest here. SSC CGL examiner humesha 'Monthly' aur 'Annual' keywords ke beech me jalebi banata hai. Screen par question padhte waqt aankho se 'Monthly/Annual' ko underline karne ki aadat daal.
